packs.name: Nexus Core: Astral Ascension
packs.description: Signature Nexus RP crossover pack utilizing 21-digit arbitrary-precision numeric code strings and dual Yu-Gi-Oh!/MTG mechanics.

cards.name: Astral Cyber Dragon Sovereign
cards.abilityText: Omni-Summon: You may deploy this card onto any Monster, Creature, or Hybrid Lane. Once per turn (Chain Speed 2): Negate a rival activation and double this unit's ATK or Power until End Phase.

cards.name: Chrono-Weave Nexus Gate
cards.abilityText: Field / Enchantment: Players may treat Lands as Spell/Trap Zones. Once during your Main Phase, draw 1 card and gain 1000000000000 LP if you control an Astral unit.

cards.name: Aetherial Rift Vanguard
cards.abilityText: Flash / Quick Effect: Deploy from hand during either player's Combat Phase. Target allied unit cannot be destroyed by battle or targeted effects this turn.

cards.name: Singularity Overdrive Pulse
cards.abilityText: Instant / Quick-Play Spell: Counter target spell or chain link on the Stack, then deal 2000 damage (or 4 loyalty damage) to target opponent or Planeswalker.

packs.name: Duelist Archive: Classic Staples
packs.description: Classic 8-digit passcode style Yu-Gi-Oh! archetype references built for 5-Zone and Speed Duel 3-Zone testing.

cards.name: Azure-Eyes Plasma Dragon
cards.abilityText: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of astral destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

cards.name: Obsidian Rift Arcanist
cards.abilityText: The ultimate spellcaster in terms of attack and dimensional defense. Gains 300 ATK for each Spell in your Graveyard during RP Turbo Duels.

cards.name: Starlight Space Typhoon
cards.abilityText: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

cards.name: Aegis Mirror Barrier
cards.abilityText: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

packs.name: Multiverse Sparks: Planeswalker Set
packs.description: UUID-indexed MTG-compatible custom cards with Mana Cost, Power, Toughness, and Planeswalker Loyalty attributes.

cards.name: Seraphina, Architect of Lanes
cards.abilityText:
+2: Scry 2, then draw a card.
-3: Exile target nonland permanent until Seraphina leaves the battlefield.
-8: You get an emblem with 'Spells you cast cost 3 less and cannot be countered.'

cards.name: Spire of the Convergent Nexus
cards.abilityText: Tap: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast multi-ruleset spells or activate Nexus abilities.

cards.name: Obsidian Rift Sentinel
cards.abilityText: Flying, Vigilance. Whenever Obsidian Rift Sentinel attacks, tap target creature defending player controls.

cards.name: Aether Spark Discharge
cards.abilityText: Aether Spark Discharge deals 3 damage to any target. If you control a Nexus permanent, draw a card.

starterDecks.name: Astral Convergence Hybrid
starterDecks.description: Balanced crossover deck combining 21-digit Nexus Sovereign boss monsters with MTG instants and classic Yu-Gi-Oh! staples.

starterDecks.name: Duelist Archive 5-Zone
starterDecks.description: Streamlined Yu-Gi-Oh! test deck ready for 5-Zone and Speed Duel 3-Zone formats.

starterDecks.name: Spire Tempo Control
starterDecks.description: Blue-White-Red tempo shell featuring Seraphina, Convergent Nexus lands, and stack interaction.
